<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"a08c8886041144394311e48e569e2fc241dcf6e55e228a0d1d66171077ecaf38"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — v2.dramafren.org/popular/ hijacks the first click with an invisible #⁠safePopupArea overlay and opens an ad pop-up tab (otieu.com); the dd133.com ad tag is already blocked, so the fix is v2.dramafren.org#⁠%#⁠//scriptlet('prevent-window-open'). The experiment recorded pop-ups in phases A and B but none with the candidate (1/1/0) with page integrity intact, yet the vision review stayed inconclusive because an invisible overlay and a pop-up tab cannot be seen in static screenshots, so the rule goes to human review unverified.

## Candidate for review

`v2.dramafren.org#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: apply_rule environmentExperiment was inconclusive:⁠ the visual review returned verdict inconclusive, symptom 'unclear', pageIntegrity 'intact', adLayoutResidue 'absent', remainingInstances empty and observedDamage empty, with no failedCandidateChecks. The reported defect is behavioral — an invisible full-page #⁠safePopupArea overlay captures the first click and opens an ad tab to otieu.com — so static phase screenshots cannot show it (completed full-page vision of the proxied session reports reporterSymptomPresence 'absent' for the same reason). The experiment's revealSteps nevertheless recorded popupsOpened 1 (phase A), 1 (phase B baseline) and 0 (phase C with the candidate), so the candidate stopped the ad pop-up without touching page content; it needs a human to accept that behavioral proof.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44655277306

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `6ea8c05`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://dein-einbuergerungstest.de/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdein-einbuergerungstest.de%2F)

### Comment
> Please review a suspected AdGuard Safe Browsing false positive affecting https://dein-einbuergerungstest.de/ and https://www.dein-einbuergerungstest.de/.
> 
> IMPORTANT CONFIGURATION CAVEAT: The actual upstream DNS server behind the affected Wi-Fi/router is UNKNOWN. "AdGuard DNS Default server" was selected only because this form requires a server choice and offers no Unknown option. It is not a confirmed description of the affected network. A direct query to AdGuard's Default DNS-over-HTTPS endpoint currently returns the correct address; the problem is not reproduced on every AdGuard resolver path.
> 
> This is an independent educational website for practising the German citizenship test (Einbuergerungstest), operated by PRIMECODE SOLUTIONS S.R.L. It is not a government website. Optional account sign-in and progress synchronisation use Firebase.
> 
> Observed on 16 November 2026 (system DNS/HTTPS check at 22:07 UTC), macOS 26.7.3:
> - System hostname resolution returns 94.140.14.33.
> - The HTTP response is an AdGuard DNS block page containing PAGE_TYPE = 'safebrowsing'.
> - HTTPS fails with ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR in a fresh Chrome profile (Chrome 157.0.8103.79); apex and www are affected in system HTTPS checks.
> - Google and Cloudflare DNS return 199.36.158.100. Direct AdGuard Default DoH also returns 199.36.158.100 during this investigation.
> - Connecting the domain directly to 199.36.158.100 returns HTTP 200 with valid TLS. The Firebase hosting address https://einbuergerung-lernen.web.app/ also works. The owner reports that the site works over 5G.
> 
> Screenshots: the first shows the actual Chrome connection error on the affected network. The second shows the same HTTPS website loaded in a separate test browser with a temporary hostname-to-199.36.158.100 mapping, with normal TLS certificate validation. No system DNS or router settings were changed. The comparison bypasses the affected DNS result; it does not establish which router upstream is responsible.
> 
> Please review the domain's Safe Browsing classification and remove any erroneous listing if applicable. Given the different resolver results, please also advise whether this could be a cached classification or a different filtering upstream, and how to identify the responsible list. Thank you.
>

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.youtube.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F) ### Comment > **Problem: YouTube playlist repeat switches off when AdGuard is enabled.** > > For approximately four months, YouTube's playlist repeat function has stopped working correctly in Google Chrome. > > When I enable repeat, it switches off when the next video starts. <!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"4ca2c3c78213d95576d9b0a4143017915e4620ed16d1a01b08869e91b65b025c"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Full-page vision of the prepared reporter session shows kick.com's live player, chat and layout intact; the only rule acting on litix.io is the Tracking Protection line ||litix.io^, blocking the player's Mux telemetry beacons (4 in \~2.5 min) at a steady, non-runaway cadence. The site-scoped exception @⁠@⁠||litix.io^$domain=kick.com was tested twice but could not be verified (inconclusive, then rejected because a mature-content gate hid the player), and unblocking a tracker with no proven functional break is a maintainer call, so no rule is proposed.

## Still visible after the rule

- Main center livestream player region, below the header and left of the Chat panel — The live-stream video content is not visible; the player area is black and only shows a mature-viewer age gate with text and 'I am 18+' / 'Cancel' controls. The gated stream content is withheld/missing, so the live-stream player is not visibly working.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44666386592
